scope: No density-norm comparison may be inferred merely from A^2 >= C^2, or even from equality A^2=C^2. Deterministic square-certificate transfer remains valid when consumed by an actual-final-matrix receiver.
counterexample: For independent X,Y uniform on [-1/2,1/2], A_plus=diag(1,1) and A_minus=diag(1,-1) satisfy A_plus^2=A_minus^2=I_2. The law of X^2+Y^2 has density <=pi, while p_{X^2-Y^2}(t)>=log(1/(8t)) for 0<t<1/8 and therefore has infinite essential supremum.
target_effect: This is not a counterexample to QFORM-FULL because it has only two eigenvalues of modulus at least one.
